summary_en: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s scheduled visit to Japan on 26 October 2026 comes at a significant moment in Bangladesh-Japan relations, as Dhaka seeks to deepen economic and strategic engagement with Tokyo. During the visit, Bangladesh is set to propose a US$14 billion investment and cooperation package spanning 12 priority sectors, including transport, technology and energy. The visit provides an opportunity to assess the evolving bilateral partnership and identify avenues for expanding cooperation in an increasingly complex regional geopolitical environment.

The July 2024 uprising in Bangladesh was primarily triggered by anger over a controversial court ruling that restored a discriminatory 56% civil service job quota system (which reserved 30% of public jobs for descendants of 1971 independence war veterans), combined with a violent state crackdown on student demonstrators.

summary_en: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman reached Tokyo this morning (local time) on a four-day official visit at the invitation of his Japanese counterpart Sanae Takaichi, with the visit aimed at deepening bilateral ties, attracting investment and expanding trade and development cooperation.

summary_en: Many people use Bluetooth technology to connect headphones or computers to mobile phones, but did you know? Behind the name of this modern technology is a history that is more than a thousand years old. It is associated with the story of a Viking king of Denmark.
